verdict.rationale: BAMF is Germany's Federal Office for Migration and Refugees, a government authority that provides migration, asylum and integration information and services. It is not a software or AI product where users configure data-use or model-training settings, so an AI-training opt-out story is a category error for this kind of entity. Nothing in the evidence shows BAMF ships any user-facing AI-training control that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
